data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to add a bouncing scale animation to any child widget.
data.what_it_does: Encapsulates any widget with a BouncingWidget to provide a scaling bounce animation on click. It allows customization of the scale factor and animation duration.
use_when: You want to add tactile feedback animations to buttons or clickable elements.
You need a simple bounce effect when a user presses a widget.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based multi-element animations.
You require state management or routing solutions.
strengths: Easy to use by wrapping any widget
weaknesses: Limited to a basic scale bounce effect
